fact_english: Young Philippine sailfin lizards can run short distances across the surface of water; adults get too heavy to do it.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang batang ibid, ang Philippine sailfin lizard, kayang tumakbo sa ibabaw ng tubig, saglit lang!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Pag tumanda at bumigat, lulubog na. Parang ako pagkatapos ng Pasko.

after_text: Hindi siya nagbiro, inamoy niya ako, at umatras.
why_here: The present-day scene ends here: Indio tells how Usman did not joke but smelled him and backed away, and right after, the story jumps to Maynila in 1570 (a new paragraph, 0.94 s gap). Moved on 13 Nov because the old cut came between Usman's question and Indio's line telling his reaction, which split one thought, and it put the break's joke right before 'Hindi siya nagbiro'.
